contact_cards.title: Contact form
contact_cards.desc: Send your question via the contact page

steps.text: Enter text to convert in the input box (limit depends on your plan).
Select a voice from the built-in library or your personal voices.
Choose emotion if needed: Neutral, Happy, Calm, Excited, Sad.
Click "Convert" and wait for processing. Download the WAV file.
Go to "My Voices" in the navigation menu.
Upload a sample audio file (WAV/MP3, at least 10 seconds, clear quality).
The system processes and creates your voice clone in a few minutes.
Use your cloned voice when converting text to speech.

faqs.question: How many characters can I use per month?
faqs.answer_html: The free plan includes a limited number of characters per month. Paid plans offer higher quotas. See details on Pricing.

faqs.question: Can I use generated audio for commercial purposes?
faqs.answer_html: With paid plans, you may use audio for personal and commercial purposes. However, you may not use it for deepfake or fraudulent content. See Terms of Service for more.

faqs.question: Is my uploaded voice file kept secure?
faqs.answer_html: Yes. Your voice files are only used to create your personal clone model, are not shared with third parties, and are not used to train our AI without your consent.

faqs.question: I forgot my password — what should I do?
faqs.answer_html: Please contact danhvt388@gmail.com with your account email for a manual password reset. Self-service password reset will be added soon.

faqs.question: I want to delete my account and all data?
faqs.answer_html: Email danhvt388@gmail.com with subject "Data deletion request". We will process within 30 days. See Data Deletion Policy for details.

faqs.question: Why is audio quality sometimes inconsistent?
faqs.answer_html: VietVoice is in Beta. Voice quality depends on the AI model and input text. Technical terms, proper names, or very long sentences may affect quality. Please report issues so we can improve.

faqs.question: Payment failed but money was deducted?
faqs.answer_html: Contact danhvt388@gmail.com with a screenshot of the transaction. We will verify and respond within 24 hours.
